subject: ISV technical trajectory: LangChain / LlamaIndex SDK certification & tracing handoff
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver@promptforge.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: PromptForge Partnerships <partners@promptforge.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — PromptForge x Redwood SDK certification opportunity

Hi Jasmine — great speaking briefly at the partner summit. Ellen and I talked through a lightweight certification path for PromptForge's LangChain / LlamaIndex wrappers that would prove compatibility with Redwood's tracing hooks and token attribution.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a short technical checklist + a 2-week sandbox window where we can run our adapter, exercise streaming + tracing, and collect telemetry? We're targeting an early Q4 marketplace listing.

Attachments: promptforge-sdk-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet — mapping of their adapter surface to LangChain/LlamaIndex hooks)

Quick answers we need from your side to scope:
- Required trace span names and mandatory fields for Redwood tracing?
- Preferred test harness (postman vs small python harness)?
- Any restrictions on telemetry payloads (PII/data retention)?

Thanks — Oliver
PromptForge — Partnerships
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <oliver@promptforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISV technical trajectory: LangChain / LlamaIndex SDK certification & tracing handoff

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We'll definitely prioritize a short certification path; my immediate proposal:

1) Sandbox window: 2 weeks (staging cluster) — Redwood will open an instrumented sandbox and provision a test model instance.
2) Checklist: we have a minimal instrumentation checklist and a test harness (python + pytest snippets) that covers streaming, KV caching warmups, and span propagation. I'll attach the checklist and a sample harness.
3) Data & telemetry: Redwood retains telemetry for 30 days in staging by default; we can enable a reduced retention mode for your team if needed (GDPR-friendly).

Action items I can take right now:
- Share the tracing-instrumentation-checklist.pdf and the harness repo link.
- Loop in Marissa for certification gating (contract/marketplace onboarding) and Karthik for trace expectations and perf targets.

Could you confirm the proposed sandbox dates (we have availability Sep 7–21) and whether the adapter needs special kernel/quantization testing?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISV technical trajectory: LangChain / LlamaIndex SDK certification & tracing handoff

Looping in marketplace & certification owners. A couple of notes from the ops side:

- Certification gates: functional compatibility (LangChain/LlamaIndex embeddings + chunking), tracing required fields, and a lightweight perf test (p95 token latency under defined env). We'll create a checklist entry for each.
- Legal/payment: PromptForge is requesting the sandbox free of charge for the certification window; we usually grant a single 2-week sandbox for ISV certs under a standard MOU. Vanessa — can you own the MOU and marketplace listing steps?

Also Karthik — can you confirm the tracing span name conventions and whether we require a specific sampling flag for adapters (we prefer not to force sampling changes on partners).

Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Park <oliver@promptforge.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Zhao <ellen@promptforge.ai>, PromptForge Partnerships <partners@promptforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISV technical trajectory: LangChain / LlamaIndex SDK certification & tracing handoff

Thanks team — Sep 7–21 works for us. A few clarifications:

- We'll sign your standard MOU for a complimentary sandbox; please send the MOU (DocuSign link is fine).
- The adapter needs to exercise streaming + function-calling paths and expose Trace IDs as headers so you can correlate across services. We'll also run an internal perf run focused on 32-token + 512-token sequences — can you confirm the model variant you'll provision (we'll need compatibility notes if it's quantized).
- Attached: tracing-instrumentation-checklist.pdf (filled by PromptForge) — we've annotated where we believe mapping is 1:1 and where we need Redwood guidance.

Next steps: Jasmine to send harness link + staging endpoint details; Vanessa to circulate MOU/marketplace onboarding checklist; Karthik to confirm required trace fields and sampling guidance.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Oliver
PromptForge — Head of Partnerships

Attachments: tracing-instrumentation-checklist.pdf (annotated)
